name: learning-compute
description: Learning compute orchestration service (W048): the COMPUTE ORCHESTRATION CONTRACT for generating episodes at scale. planGeneration is THE GATE: the population re-proven through W045's own whole-record validator (errors carried verbatim), the batch policy proven against W047's declared selection-policy vocabulary, the sharding policy validated as DECLARED closed-set data (axis vocabulary, shard count, per-unit episode quota; canonical member-order contiguous assignment — every shard non-empty), then the GenerationPlan sealed: content-addressed genplan-<digest> id, the work units as DATA (each: its shard assignment + its population slice + its declared batch descriptor + its declared world/scope), immutable population lineage, deterministic provenance. port.ts types the GenerationWorkerPort (claim unit → emit batch reference) — the surface a future distributed runtime executes. A14: this service COMPOSES typed plans — it never executes generation, never touches a network, never spawns processes, never reads clocks/env/node ids (distribution is DECLARED as data, never discovered). W049 (JAX-LOB training adapter) consumes these plans; W050 owns the Time Machine.
